market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $35,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$76K needs to dip to $35,000 — a ~54% drawdown — by end of 2026. Even with BTC's high volatility, a >50% drawdown in 8 months is rare without a major crisis or cascading liquidations. Historically Bitcoin has had drawdowns of this magnitude over 12-month windows during full bear markets (2022), but starting from a non-bubble level and given current ETF/structural demand, this looks low probability ~8-12%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Severe macro shock or large exchange/regulatory event could trigger this kind of cascade.
